notes.title: Free Expansion: Gamble Tower All In is now available!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! It is finally here!
Not much else to say, just a lot of patch notes to unravel.

Go play it now! Just download the latest update and you'll be set! :)

[b]Just some more info:[/b]
[olist]
[*] I don't remember everything we added, so there will be a lot that you won't see on the patch notes, go play it to find out new stuff!
[*] We'll keep patching the game with bugfixes, QOL and more! If you find any bugs, crashes or have any suggestions please report it to us on [url=https://discord.gg/4N2UWEx]our Discord[/url] or through [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1577460/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url].
[*] While I don't guarantee new content we really want to modify and have some new Traits (and new Achievements), since we ran out of time to do that this [i]might[/i] happen in a future smaller content patch.
[*] I may play the game live or on YouTube in order to find new bugs and also to create some guides for the unlocks, I'll let you guys know if this actually ends up happening.
[*] Have lots of fun!
[/olist]

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[h2]Balancing and Revamps[/h2]
[h3]Loadouts[/h3]
[list]
[*] Elf’s “Druid” loadout was modified (Added Domesticate)
[*] Human’s “Engineer” loadout was modified. (Added Turret)
[*] Human’s “Berserker” loadout was modified. (Added Berserk Hit)
[*] Elven Charm now triggers upon using 0 cost orbs instead of triggering when using an orb while you have 0 mana.
[/list]
[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*] Revamped Inn Master at the Tower, she should now sell drink artifacts.
[/list]
[h2]Content[/h2]
[h3]Major Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] MacZee now appears at the Tower and the Inn after being unlocked, allowing you to customize loadouts and change initial artifacts.
[*] Added 18 new acquirable upgrade crystals. (unlock them at the Inn)
[*] Added more than 15 new neutral orbs. (unlock some of them at the Inn)
[*] Added several new Elf orbs. (unlock some of them at the Inn)
[*] Added several new Human orbs. (unlock some of them at the Inn)
[*] Added several new Demon orbs. (unlock some of them at the Inn)
[*] Added 15 new acquirable and unlockable artifacts.
[*] Added acquirable shop and gamble rerolls.
[*] Added Elite Mode
[*] Added 3 new bosses.
[*] Added a new miniboss
[*] Added two final endings: One for those seeking closure, and another for those seeking wealth.
[*] Most enemies now have Elite counterparts, totalizing 12 new enemies. (and Elite capturable orbs)
[*] Added 6 new clan loadouts.
[*] You can buy 5 unique non-clan characters and pets from a new secret salesman, including a duck.
[*] Added 7 new Tower Dangers, including 3 Elite Dangers. (12 Tower Dangers in Total)
[*] Added Elite Gambles, which include plenty of new rewards, punishes and challenges.
[*] Added several new events. (And rebalanced odds of events appearing for better distribution)
[*] Added the Elite Skill Tier, which adds 3 new Elite Skills for each clan. (9 new Skills total)
[/list]
[h3]Art[/h3]
[list]
[*] Remade the Rainstorm Background
[*] Since the new Backgrounds is rendered natively using Particles instead of using a Video Player, this should increase the compatibility in certain systems (Because Unity’s Video Player can be a bit problematic).
[*] Improved the Lighting on Character Rendering, allowing certain body parts/textures to glow in the dark.
[*] Added VFXs for multiple Status Effects, including both new and existing ones.
[/list]
[h3]Progression[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased Clan Level Cap from 4 to 8.
[*] Increased Gambler Level Cap from 5 to 10.
[/list]
[h2]NPCs[/h2]
[list]
[*] MacZee can now appear at the Inn and the Tower after being unlocked.
[*] Krystaloblin can now appear at the Inn after being unlocked.
[*] A secret someone can appear at the Inn after being unlocked.
[/list]
[h2]Artifacts[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added “Compass” Human Loadout Artifact
[*] Added “Evil Runestone” Demon Loadout Artifact
[*] Added “Magic Plant” Elf Loadout Artifact
[*] Added 12+ other artifacts both for Neutral and Clans.
[/list]
[h2]Orbs[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added 11 new clan orbs for loadouts.
[*] Added Grapple (Human Wrestler)
[*] Added Toss (Human Wrestler)
[*] Added Wrestling Bandana (Human Wrestler)
[*] Added Turret (Human Engineer)
[*] Added Berserk Hit (Demon Berserker)
[*] Added Sampling (Demon Metamorph)
[*] Added Metamorphosis (Demon Metamorph)
[*] Added Metamorph’s Trident (Demon Metamorph)
[*] Added Domesticate (Elf Druid)
[*] Added Elven Charge (Elf Shaman)
[*] Added Shamanic Ritual (Elf Shaman)
[*] Added a bunch of new capturable orbs
[*] Added a bunch of new neutral orbs
[*] Added a bunch of new clan orbs
[/list]
[h2]Loadouts[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added acquirable “Shaman” loadout for Elf Clan. (You can acquire it at the Inn Orb Shop)
[*] Added acquirable “Metamorph” loadout for Demon Clan. (You can acquire it at the Inn Orb Shop)
[*] Added acquirable “Wrestler” loadout for Human Clan. (You can acquire it at the Inn Orb Shop)
[*] Added acquirable “Dealer” loadout for Elf Clan. (You can acquire it at the Inn Orb Shop)
[*] Added acquirable “Cheater” loadout for Demon Clan. (You can acquire it at the Inn Orb Shop)
[*] Added acquirable “Risktaker” loadout for Human Clan. (You can acquire it at the Inn Orb Shop)
[*] Added 6 new clan loadout artifacts. (2 for each clan)
[*] Added 5 special character loadouts
[/list]
[h2]Audio[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added lots of new voicelines.
[*] Added lots of new songs.
[*] All endings are now (basically) fully voiced.
[/list]
[h2]HUD[/h2]
[list]
[*] HUD Elements for Gambles were completely redesigned.
[*] Certain Gambles (Such as “No Repetition”) will now show important information related to them.
[*] Round/Turn HUD Element was also completely redesigned.
[*] Pet Pouch and Artifact Pouch buttons were moved to the Left Side, alongside the rest of your Character’s Loadout.
[*] The Combat Speed option is now hidden, until you hover the mouse above the Gear Menu. (It will show up for 5s when the combat starts to point out its existence).
[/list]
[h2]UI[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Character Selection Screen was completely redesigned.
[*] This also includes the information about your characters on the Gear Menu (Pause).
[*] Added an Option to skip the Intro under Settings -> Interface
[*] Warning: Skipping the intro will also skip the Epilepsy Warning.
[*] Revamped the Credits Section.
[*] Revamped the Skill Allocation Menu to accommodate for Elite Skills and provide better feedback on Skill Point Cost/Limit.
[*] The Gamble Selection Menu on the Intersection was redesigned to accommodate 4 Gambles being displayed.
[/list]
[h2]QOL[/h2]
[list]
[*] Some Particle Effects can be Controlled by a Quality Setting in the Options menu, including the new Rainstorm Effect and Many other Particle Effects.
[*] Tower Dangers now remain selected between expeditions
[*] You can now discard Characters and Pets.
[*] Added a button to clear all Tower Dangers selected.
[/list]
[h2]Localization[/h2]
[list]
[*] [PT-BR] Localized all of the dialogues that were missing Localization
[*] [PT-BR] Localized multiple missing strings on the Skill HUD
[*] [PT-BR] Localized some tooltips on the Intersection
[*] [PT-BR] Localized the Epilepsy Warning
[*] [PT-BR] Localized the Credits and the Main Menu Discord Button.
[*] [PT-BR] Localized tooltips for Flames and Banished Pile
[*] With this, the game should be fully localized in PT-BR.
[*] Se você encontrar algum texto não traduzido, ou algum erro de tradução, por favor reporte o erro para nós.
[/list]
[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[i]Please note that I don't actually remember all the bugs that we fixed, we probably fixed a lot more.
(That doesn't stop new ones from appearing though :<)[/i]
[h3]Most Important Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the game would softlock if a character with the “Sped up” buff died before acting.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game wouldn’t pause when you entered the Gear Menu.
[*] Fixed an issue where tooltips would disappear permanently.
[*] Fixed an issue where Janitor would appear multiple times at the ending.
[/list]
[h3]Functionality[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where round was sometimes instantly skipped when the first enemy in the queue died before acting.
[*] Fixed issue where Sleeping characters wouldn’t show the “My Turn” widget.
[/list]
[h3]UI and UX[/h3]
[list]
[*] Caffeine Addict should no longer leave Sleep as a 0 stack ailment, it won’t appear at all instead.
[*] Mana Cost should no longer appear on the top of the Lootbox animations anymore
[/list]
[h3]Audiovisual[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where Mana values would appear above Boss Lootbox.
[*] Better aligned target areas for some characters like Drakobold
[*] Broken Toys should no longer visually affect artifacts if the gamble is inactive.
[/list]
[h3]Localization and Text[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where names would not be localized in temporary dialogues.
[*] Fixed issue where “Discarded” would appear on Upgrade Crystal frames.
[*] Fixed a bunch of weird localization issues.
[/list]

Thank you for stopping by!

notes.title: Announcing the All In Expansion
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I hope you are doing fantastic!
I come here today to proudly announce the [b]All In Expansion[/b] for Gamble Tower!

[h1]What is the All In Expansion?[/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/CTkiiXB.png[/img]
You can call it the All In Expansion, All In Update or just 1.1.
This is the final name for the update that we were previously naming 1.1.

[h2]What does it add?[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/WXKL6Rw.gif[/img]
[i](What a full Inn!)[/i]
We are adding a lot of content, doubling a lot of the existing variety of content currently in the game.
So this includes things such as:
[list]
[*] 18 new Upgrade Crystals
[*] 16 new Artifacts
[*] 6 new Clan Loadouts (2 for each clan)
[*] Rerolls for everything! (Gambles, shops, etc.)
[*] 3 new Elite boss fights.
[*] 3 new Inn NPCs.
[*] 8 new Tower Dangers, including 3 Elite Tower Dangers
[*] Level caps are doubled! Clans now go up to level 8 and Gambler up to level 10!
[*] Elite Gambles!
[*] New events!
[*] New acquirable Orbs, both for clans and neutral ones!
[*] Elite variants for every enemy in the game. (essentially 12 new enemies)
[*] And more!
[/list]
[h2]Why "All In?"[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ptKUS5H.gif[/img]
I wanted something gamble themed, we thought about "[b]High Stakes[/b]", "[b]Double or Nothing[/b]" and some other ones, but in the end I think that "[b]All In[/b]" was the proper one.
Being the first and last major update planned for Gamble Tower, I think it is a good name.

[h3]Last Update?[/h3]
This is the last content update planned, but we will still update the game with bugfixes, balancing patches and quality of life features.
Nothing is stopping us from releasing other content updates and expansions in the future, but I think it is important to be clear that there is currently no plans for that.

[h2]When will it release?[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/bg4zHp4.gif[/img]
There will be two releases:

[h3]Unstable[/h3]
The Unstable version will be a less polished (and realistically, unstable/buggy) version available later this month [i](November 2023)[/i] on a specific password-protected Steam branch.
If you want to help us playtest the update and have early access to it, [url=https://discord.com/invite/4N2UWEx]join our discord.[/url]
We'll announce the password that you need to insert on the game's settings on Steam in order to access this version, but only on Discord. (we want to keep the playtest manageable.)

[h3]Stable[/h3]
The Stable version is the proper release of the update, it is planned to be available early December.
Anyone who owns Gamble Tower will have access to this expansion just by downloading the latest Steam update when it is available.
If everything goes as planned, expect it to be available around December 9th.

[h2]Will you show some of the content?[/h2]
Yes! Let's do it.
[i]Please be aware that content shown here is work in progress![/i]

[h1]Elites! Elites Everywhere![/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/rAdqyy0.gif[/img]
A big part of this update is that I wanted to really amp-up the difficulty for those players who are seeking a bigger challenge, therefore we decided to add what we call [b]Elite Mode[/b].

[h2]How to get it?[/h2]
Elite Mode is unlocked upon finding the Janitor or reaching the top while having 5 Tower Dangers active. If you already did that, when you start the game with [b]All In Expansion[/b], it will be automatically unlocked.

[h2]What is it?[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/XrHJUHn.gif[/img]
After being unlocked, Elite Mode is activated if you have a Danger Level of 3 or more. [i](each Tower Danger active will increase the Danger Level by 1, Elite Tower Dangers increase it by 3.)[/i]

In essence, Elite Mode enables Elite Gambles which then enables Elite Enemies and Elite Bosses. 

[h2]Why would I do it?[/h2]
There are several unlockables that you can only unlock by defeating Elite bosses, rewards are much more generous in this mode and you get more XP/GC.
But the main idea is, of course, providing a bigger challenge than ever before.

[h1]What else?[/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3CC0F82.gif[/img]
I think that is it for now! I prefer that you play the game and discover the content by yourself, I also dislike overpromising, so I just announced what we already have developed.
We plan to keep adding variety (specially Orbs, Events, maybe Skills and Traits) until the release happens.

Until then, I hope you look forward into playing our update!
See you next time, and remember to [url=https://discord.com/invite/4N2UWEx]join our discord[/url] to play the expansion early!

- Ian

notes.title: Sneak Peek: Loadout Customization and Bank NPC
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 
Now that September is over, we are finally able to focus on the brand new update for Gamble Tower: 1.1!

As promised, here is a sneak peek of some of the features that are going to be present in this new content patch, please remember that everything you see is still a big W.I.P!

[h1]Before the sneak peek[/h1]
[b]We got a developer page! Please follow us![/b] :)
https://store.steampowered.com/dev/indiebuild


If you want frequent updates, we have several secondary platforms where we post Gamble Tower content that you may wish to follow or join, based on frequency:
[list]
[*][url=https://discord.gg/4N2UWEx][b]Discord[/b] [i](very frequent updates)[/i][/url]
[*][url=https://www.twitch.tv/indiebuild][b]Twitch[/b] [i](used to be daily, now it's usually weekly)[/i][/url]
[*][url=https://www.youtube.com/@Indiebuild][b]YouTube[/b] [i](monthly-ish...?)[/i][/url]
[*][url=https://twitter.com/gambletower][b]X?[/b] [i](our good friend Erik handles this platform)[/i][/url]
[/list]
[h1]The Bank[/h1]
After showing the concept art for the bank NPC for so long, I am glad to announce that he is finally [b]in-game and almost fully implemented![/b] and he is fully 3D! (Because why not?)
[img]https://i.imgur.com/d2SXGX2.gif[/img]
Stebanks MacZee shows up [b]both at the Inn and at the Tower[/b] after you pay the ludicrous amount of 10.000 gold coins to Inn Master. [i](you need to be at Gambler Level 5)[/i]

He provides different services in the different locations he appears, so we'll showcase them separately.

[h2]Bank at Expeditions[/h2]
During expeditions, MacZee has a chance to appear as an intersection NPC on the left side of the Gambler, just like Stebax and Inn Master.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZT5msZd.gif[/img]

He'll provide you with two different banking services when you talk to him:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/KyKswoh.png[/img]

[h3]Currency Banking (Withdrawal and Deposit)[/h3]
If you are overflowing with cash, you can conveniently exchange your Inn's gold coins for Gambling Chips by using the withdrawal service.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/08KZ4yj.png[/img]
This allows you to get up to 500 GC per encounter with MacZee. [i](It is a 2:1 exchange rate though, so you will pay 1000 coins per 500 GC.)[/i]

If you are not feeling that rich or if you have A LOT of chips and are afraid of dying early, you can safely deposit as many GC you want and instantly convert them into Inn Gold Coins for posterior usage.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/8gG6FCb.png[/img]
It is a fair exchange rate of 1:1 in this case, no fees for this service.

[h3]Item Storage (Retrieve and Store Orbs)[/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/CrDaqsz.gif[/img]
You may safely store a limited amount of orbs inside Stebanks, be it to make your pouch lighter or to retrieve them later.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZtfcwSR.gif[/img]
The fee is a bit hefty [i](100 GC per storage and retrieval)[/i] but [b]items persist in between expeditions[/b]! So nothing will stop you from storing and retrieving orbs that would otherwise be VERY difficult to get early on or from completely different clans than what you are playing!

[h3]Bank Artifacts[/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/VqLoDMe.png[/img]
MacZee may or may not sell/give some random bank artifacts like Credit Cards and Lottery Tickets.
We are still testing those and seeing if they work well.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5ONGPGa.png[/img]

[h3]Loadout Customization[/h3]
You can use the orbs that you stored during expeditions to customize your pets and character loadouts [b]permanently[/b].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vL2sfWZ.png[/img]

Each orb customized makes the price go up though, so be prepared to open up your wallet.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/tJCc9bI.png[/img]

Everything I've shown so far is confirmed to be there though. (Except bank artifacts, we'll see.)

notes.title: Update 1.0.8
notes.content:
This adds plenty of QOL and fixes.
But also adds new Gambles, Capturable Orbs and one new unlockable.

We hope you enjoy it!

[h1]Balancing and Revamps[/h1]

[h2]Enemies[/h2]
[list]
[*] Mimics no longer steal 5 GC per attack.
[*] Drakobolds no longer steal 5 GC per attack.
[*] Pumpkin Lord Eskyuven now has 100 AP instead of 50.
[*] Pumpkin Lord Eskyuven now has 2 DEF instead of 1.
[*] Pumpkin Lord Eskyuven now receives 2 stacks of each buff instead of 1 upon triggering Latent Rage.
[*] Added more orbs that Orbot Galter can potentially generate.
[*] Tricksters now have 25 HP instead of 20.
[*] Banshee now has 25 ATK instead of 20.
[/list]
[h2]Orbs[/h2]
[list]
[*] Some Capturable Orbs now have different chances of being added instead of every single one of them having equal odds.
[*] Fallen Trickster Hat now costs 2 Mana instead of 4. Also gives 2 ATK.
[*] Desperate Bargain now has the “Overpowered” tag.
[*] Artifact Portmanteau now has the “Overpowered” and “Strict” tags.
[/list]

[h2]Artifacts[/h2]
[list]
[*] Mana Shard now gives 1 extra Mana on combat start in addition to giving 1 extra mana every turn.
[/list]
[h1]Content[/h1]

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added “Strict” orb tag. (Can’t be played through alternative methods.)
[*] Added “Overpowered” orb tag. (Mana cost won’t go below 10, but they have cool RGB visuals)
[/list]
[h2]New Capturable Orbs[/h2]
[list]
[*] Hollow Body now has a capturable summon.
[*] Drakobold now has a capturable weapon.
[*] Snatcher now has a capturable weapon.
[*] Trickster now has a capturable special orb… summon?
[*] All Pumpkins now have more capturable summons.
[*] Orbot Galter now has a VERY low % capturable summon.
[*] Orbot Guchris now has a VERY low % capturable summon
[/list]

[h2]New Orbs[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added Black Capture Gemstone
[/list]

[h2]New Tower and Inn Developments[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added the “Capturedex” upgrade, a Tower Upgrade that allows you to check what are the capturable orbs (and the odds of each one) from an enemy by right-clicking them. (Thanks Kaziglu Bey)
[/list]

[h2]New Unlockables[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added Black Capture Gemstone as an Unlockable.
[/list]

[h2]New Gambles[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added “Broken Toys” gamble.
[*] Added “Too Hot!” gamble.
[*] Added “Handicap X” gamble.
[*] Added “Black Capture Gemstone” reward.
[/list]
[h1]QOL[/h1]
[list]
[*] Save and Load: Changed UIs to now have a time stamp. (thanks Bloopers, Serulin and Jaqueta)
[*] Save and Load: Autosaves are now stored inside each individual save file, and are not separate saves. (Thanks Jaqueta)
[*] Inn Orb Shop: Orb Tooltips now appear by default instead of you having to hover on it.
[*] Reward Board (Levels): Orb Tooltips now appear instead of descriptions. (Won’t show Summons though)
[*] You can now see your active skills beneath your character’s HP.
[*] You can now check what you can capture from a specific character by right-clicking it. (But only if you have the Capturedex upgrade)
[*] The Camera will now widen the Field of View when playing at low Aspect Ratios, such as 16/10 and 3/2.
[*] Skills are now visible during Combat on the Left Side of the HUD.
[*] This can be toggled off under Settings > Interface.
[/list]
[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]

[h2]Most Important Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Potentially fixed a softlock where Confirm/Skip button sometimes wouldn’t work on Orb Chest. (Thanks Arkuktor)
[*] Fixed issue where orb draws and additions to hand would become inconsistent when the player succeeded a Fear check upon using an Attack Orb. (Thanks WhiteFalcon.)
[*] Fixed issue where Attack Orbs wouldn’t go to the Burnt Pile after succeeding a Fear check.
[*] Fixed issue where Levels and Expedition UI frequently overlapped other Inn UI elements. (Thanks Arkuktor)
[/list]
[h2]Functionality[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where Mana Crystal could make other Upgrade Crystal effects not execute. (Damage Crystals, Cloning Crystals, etc.)
[*] Fixed issue where Upgrade Crystals would sometimes not work if you had two or more distinct Crystals on the same orb.
[*] Potentially fixed issue where burning door would damage you even if you had the “Aggressive” trait.
[*] Fixed inconsistent Trick or Treat activations and action changes for Eskyuven. (e.g: when receiving Burning damage, he would perform ToT twice)
[*] Pouch Pocket now properly draws +1 orb on your first turn.
[*] Fixed issue where Snatcher Shop would snatch things that you didn’t really have.
[*] Fixed issue where hovering your mouse on highlighted links on the Spoils menu didn’t work well for Orb Tooltips.
[*] Fixed out of bounds exception that could happen when burning Bombkins.
[/list]
[h2]Audiovisual[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the Chest Unboxing Animation would appear incorrectly when using lower Interface Scale values.
[*] Drastically reduced Pumpkin Pile light intensity.
[*] “Return” button should no longer overlap the Tower Dangers button on the Inn.
[*] Added simple BG to Skill Tree
[/list]
[h2]Localization, Typos, Text[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed small text issue on “Trick” description
[*] Fixed “Gulsing” typo. (should now say “Guising”)
[*] Improved “Puppet Strings”’s description.
[*] Fixed other minor text issues.
[*] [PT-BR] Localized Mana Tooltip on the HUD.
[*] [PT-BR] Localized The Spoils “Cards”.
[*] [PT-BR] Localized Chest Unboxing UI.
[*] [PT-BR] Localized Boss Loot Box UI.
[/list]
[h2]Performance[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved the Performance of the Pouch Rendering, the resolution of the “Pouch Camera Render” (Used to render the 3D orbs inside the UI) now scales based on which resolution the game is running.
[*] Same performance improvements were made to Artifact Rendering, in both the HUD, and Artifact Pouch.
[*] These improvements will have a large impact on Systems with Integrated Graphics and Lower-end GPUs.
[*] Same Improvements were added to Character Selection screens (Buy/Borrow/Select)
[*] Additionally, the game will limit how many characters are rendered in Real-time in the UI up to 2. Rest will be frozen.
[*] Further optimizations were made as well, all of these improvements should give a huge performance boost when selecting characters, especially for a large collection of characters. (Thanks for reporting the performance issues Wolfgang)
[/list]
[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[i]We’ll be looking into fixing these for the next patches.[/i]
[list]
[*] There may still be a Pumpkin Lord softlock that may happen under specific conditions, we are still investigating, if you experienced it please let us know! (Thanks WhiteFalcon!)
[*] Stacked artifacts are getting out of frame.
[*] Gacha Addict progress doesn’t properly save, so if you spent 25 GC, saved and loaded, you’ll need to spend again.
[*] Red Tricksters sometimes don’t attack, we are still investigating that.
[/list]

notes.title: Updates about Playtest 2 - Plans, end date, etc.
notes.content:
Hi everyone, I hope you are doing well.

We have some new info to share about our current ongoing Playtest, but first off let me start by saying that this Playtest has been an amazing experience, and we are grateful to all of you for your feedback and support.

Before anything else, in case you are not playing the Playtest yet, it is currently public and on!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/8rnS3l9.png[/img]
That means that even if you don't have access, you'll gain access instantly just by clicking the button above on our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1577460/Gamble_Tower/]Steam page[/url], so why not play it? :)

[h2]Ending the Playtest on May 22nd[/h2]
Curiously enough, when we started the Playtest I totally forgot about defining an end date. 
(I guess I was more interested in making it live than ending it :P)
So, as the header says... We'll be ending Playtest 2 on May 22nd, 2023. 
We encourage all of our players to continue playing and providing feedback until then. This will help us make the game even better for its next milestones, and far less buggy as well.

[h2]What we've added so far[/h2]
So far we have worked on several new features (some very experimental) in order to improve the current experience of the game and also to add more to it in general, some examples being:

-[b]Loadouts/Classes [/b]
https://imgur.com/W5mOhUm

[i](Now every character has different orb loadouts based on their clans)[/i]

- [b]Inn Master NPC and Skill Rewards[/b]
https://imgur.com/vQXmWdp

[i](Inn Master now appears during expeditions, and you may acquire healing mugs or skills)[/i]

- [b]Loan Shark Cupcake [/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/lpKnAZ1.png[/img]
[i]([url=https://www.twitch.tv/indiebuild]Made during a livestream[/url], we improved the utility of Loan Shark characters, making so that you can farm coins much more easily when playing with them)[/i]

Be aware that most of those new features were ideas given directly by you guys ([url=https://discord.gg/4N2UWEx]specifically on our Discord[/url], but you can post your ideas here on Steam as well), so if you have any suggestion, please let us know!

By the way, you can check details about every new update made in-game, by going to News > Changelogs.
https://imgur.com/pZhOoCT
[i](Changelog Example)[/i]

[h2]What we still want to add[/h2]
For this week (from May 8th to May 14th), we'll be experimenting with some new content that we want to add as well, we are not entirely sure what of those features are going to make it in time, but the plans are to add:
- [b]A bank NPC.[/b] [i](concept art below)[/i]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/4oJJebE.png[/img]
- [b]Boss lootboxes, with 3 unique boss artifacts.[/b]
- [b]Maaaaybe some kind of elite enemies/mechanics.[/b] [i](I really want to add this, but I don't believe we'll have the time right now)[/i]

Now, be aware that of course our main focus is to make the game as bug-free as humanly possible during the time we have the Playtest live, so any kind of bug usually takes priority over any new feature we want to add.

[h2]Plans after the Playtest[/h2]
Okay, so for after the Playtest is finished, we have two more milestones to go. Here's a sneak peek of what's to come:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/q6x8rZ8.png[/img]
You can also access the roadmap in-game, by clicking [b]Roadmap[/b] on the Main Menu.

To be a bit more specific, the Prologue is planned to release possibly by the end of June or the start of July. We'll be simultaneously working on the final product while we work on the Prologue, so we may have the release (take this one with a biiig grain of salt) by the end of August.

Realistically, I would expect September or even October to be more reasonable, but it will all depend on how much I'll be able to work and how much progress we'll be able to make on the next months.

[h2]Thank you![/h2]
Thank you for your continued support and feedback. We can't wait for you to see what we have in store for the future of our game.
Be well, friends. :D

Best regards, Ian.

notes.title: Announcing Gamble Tower's Playtest 2
notes.content:
[h1]Playtest 2.0[/h1]

Hello everyone, long time no see.
We have exciting news to share about Gamble Tower's Closed Beta II! (also known as Playtest 2)

If you don't want to read aaaall that information below, just know that...
[h3]We'll be starting the Playtest starting on April 29th![/h3]

[h2]New Save System[/h2]
Since the previous playtest was quite plagued with major bugs, specifically related to the very unstable saves, we wanted to focus on fixing that before working on anything else.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/8sYJIAc.gif[/img]
Thankfully, we finally found the (many) reasons why the save system was breaking, and[b] redone it entirely[/b]. This means that saving and loading games should now work without any issues (and most importantly, between versions!), and you won't have to worry about losing your progress anymore.
[i]Also, you won't have infinite autosaves now, lol.[/i]

[h2]Redesigned Second Segment Boss[/h2]
We heard your feedback and decided to redesign the second segment boss to make it more fair for different clans and builds, we are still working on it and testing the changes a bit internally but I believe it will work much better while still providing a good challenge.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/vWcRRSC.gif[/img]
[i](very W.I.P)[/i]
I won't detail the changes yet but Noxaerudeux will now be a stance boss of sorts, swapping between its Golden and Night forms under certain circunstances.

[h2]Visual Improvements and UI Tweaks[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/TNovZGC.png[/img]
We've also made lots of visual improvements and UI tweaks to the game. The game now looks better than ever, and the user interface is more intuitive and user-friendly.
Jaqueta worked on a lot of different new VFXs and visual polishes as well, [url=https://www.youtube.com/shorts/S8CJtV0lvvQ]here is a short video of some of the newest additions.[/url]

[h2]New YouTube Videos and Shorts[/h2]
We're also working on new YouTube videos and shorts to keep you updated about the game's development. [url=https://www.youtube.com/@indiebuildteam545]Be sure to check out and subscribe to our YouTube channel to stay up to date.[/url] (But only if you want to!)

[h2]Why is development taking so long?[/h2]
Ah yes, this is one classic question, with lots of different answers!
As of recently I was having little time to work on the game, I've moved (AGAIN) and only now have properly stabilished myself in my new residence.
I am now working sometimes at the office instead of purely remotely, so that kinda hinders the time that I could use to develop Gamble Tower as well...

HOWEVER, I am trying to develop the game at least a little bit every day, and hopefully that will help make the final release happen on a reasonable time this year.

Thank you for your continued support, and we can't wait for you to play the new and improved beta. See you soon! :)

- Ian

notes.title: Progress Report 04 - It's Close!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, I hope you are doing well.
Lately I've been very sick due to some kind of flu (I am still a bit sick to be honest) so I couldn't post the report on the last week.
Here is the current milestone progress:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/wTrm3Aw.png[/img]
The image looks quite similar to the previous one, but in actuality we are a lot closer to a potential Closed Beta release than it seems.
Most of the features (like New Clan Unlockables) are around 90% done, with a few last touches remaining to be finished, but that data isn't conveyed on the milestone image.

Anyway, let's start.

[h1]News and Announcements[/h1]
[h2]A Wednesday Devsnippet about Stable Diffusion![/h2]
Previously I said that I lost plenty of devsnippet footage through bare misfortune, I explain that a bit further on the beginning of this new video:
[previewyoutube=GxAZZoVKmyY;full][/previewyoutube]
This new Wednesday Devsnippet is focused on the usage of artificial intelligence image generators (like Stable Diffusion) to help speed up the process of making game art.
It is quite interesting in my opinion so if you are interested in AI, generators, game art or stuff like that, it may be worth your while! (I added plenty of resources on the description also)

[h2]Making a new NPC[/h2]
I am currently working on the Loan Shark (the character silhouette in this announcement's capsule is hers), I used SB (Stable Diffusion) to speed up the process, but the art still lacks a bunch of polish and refinement.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Dcj7yLq.png[/img]
It is interesting to see how the SB slowly works its way through a fitting result though, and yes, the Loan Shark is indeed an elderly lady.

I'll talk more about the mechanics later, but to summarize it: 
Since characters cost coins and die permanently, it is possible to enter a softlock state where you are not able to play due to not having enough characters for an expedition and also not having enough coins to buy a new character.
That's why a Loan Shark of sorts needs to exist.

[h1]Progress In-Game[/h1]
[h2]5 New community designed Upgrade Crystals![/h2]
Before getting sick I was preparing a devsnippet where I show the development of all 5 upgrade crystals ideas submitted by our [url=https://discord.gg/4N2UWEx]Discord community[/url] members.
I have shown the Toll Crystal previously, so here is another one, designed by BlackDragonMagician:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/dZhFOF8.png[/img]
There are other three crystals that I'll be showcasing on the next video, so stay tuned.

[h2]Polishes and Bugfixing[/h2]
Polishing and bugfixing is something that will have to be executed until and probably during the Closed Beta itself. Jaqueta is doing a great job polishing several VFXs and UIs in the game, take a look at the poison effect he made:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/fp29TbF.gif[/img]
(May take a huge while to load, [url=https://imgur.com/fp29TbF]so here is the direct link instead[/url])
I am mostly focusing on the bugfixing and audio part, as you'll see below.

[h2]SFX and Soundtrack[/h2]
I have been working on pending voice acting, SFX and soundtracks for the game.
On the topic of soundtrack, the dynamic battle music for the Jungle Segment has been finished
[img]https://i.imgur.com/KaWT5PY.png[/img]
There are 12 separate tracks that will alternate in play in different moments (when a character attacks, dies, on enemy's turn, etc.), and it took around 6 different iterations to finish this song, but I think it will sound cool and fitting on the final product.

For the voice acting, I only managed to finish the Warden and the Troll for now, since my voice is absolutely dead now that I am sick, but I plan to finish all 15-ish remaining characters alongside my wife soon.

Sound effects are also being made, there aren't many instances of missing SFX but I tend to take the opportunity to do some other polishes simultaneously.

Anyway, those aren't things that can be shown unfortunately, but I hope your ears like what they hear when you play the Closed Beta! :)

[h2]Others[/h2]
[list]
[*]After testing the game for a bit, I decided that the Jungle boss is balanced for now. We'll have to collect feedback on the Closed Beta to do further balancing.
[*]We'll be taking part on the Steam Next Fest that will be happening on the end of this month. (Steam Scream Fest)
I'll be doing a proper announcement eventually.
[/list]
[h1]Plans and Wrapping Up[/h1]
For the next week, I hope to get rid of this damn flu.
And of course, I plan to address the "80%ish done" features to turn them into 100% done ones instead.
The delayed devsnippet about the Community Upgrade Crystals will be happening next week unless I am still too sick to record/edit stuff.

And I think that is it. See you soon!

notes.title: March Status Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! It has been a while.
I am back with first and foremost a [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ABHKaOurDtE]new devlog that you can watch by clicking here[/url]

And of course, a lot of new content related to Gamble Tower, along with images, gifs and all that.
Let's get started!

[h1]Inn and Meta-Progression[/h1]
[i](W.I.P - UI still in development)[/i]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/wrZ3Kee.gif[/img]

As you can see we can finally show you the Inn, There are new and familiar characters here! This is the place you go to in between expeditions, and it is where most of the meta-progression part of the game happens.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vPHgAM7.gif[/img]

You can acquire new orbs, new artifacts and new general upgrades (like a shop reroll) that will appear on future expeditions as soon as you buy them.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/BQP6CRY.png[/img]

Certain items and upgrades will only unlock when you reach specific levels, and there are currently four different types of levels.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/DcwHfuq.png[/img]

You have levels for each clan, you will unlock things for that specific clan by levelling it up by playing characters that belong to that clan.
There is also the Gambler Level, that is the "player level" that you'll get experience for just by doing expeditions, levelling up your Gambler Level will unlock content that don't belong to any specific clan.

[i](Again, W.I.P)[/i]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Fg7WSCA.png[/img]

Different ways of ending an expedition will result in different amounts and types of rewards, with those being EXP, skill points and currency.

We'll talk more about that in the future, since there is a lot to show, let me show you some of the new characters!

[h1]Warden and Randomized Characters[/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ie3JGOw.gif[/img]
The Warden is a demon skull that smokes souls, you'll always find him smoking on the left side of the counter at The Inn.

[i](Again, all UIs are still W.I.P)[/i]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/AcNDUD1.gif[/img]

The souls that aren't good enough to be smoked, are sold.
You can acquire characters and pets from different clans by talking to him and paying the price.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/pPZojfu.png[/img]

Previously (in the demo), pets and characters always had the same appearance, stats and traits, with the only variation being in the gender, that you could choose.

But we decided to change that, and now all those characteristics are randomized, so you can now have completely different characters even if they are from the exact same clan!

To support that however, we are remaking all the character templates from scratch, and that takes a bit of time. (They are already in game, but still need to have a lot of things tuned, and we didn't make the clothing for them yet.)

Before (Appearance):
[img]https://i.imgur.com/XbcbEJD.gif[/img]

After (Still being tuned):
[img]https://i.imgur.com/bOf9gRr.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZXqsFS3.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/QDjDr0K.gif[/img]

We still have plans to add more randomized appearance traits, such as body proportions, scars and more. (Besides adding more variation of hairstyles, faces, etc. of course.)

[h1]What else!?[/h1]
A lot more, we didn't even touch on Skill Trees and Tower Dangers yet, but I'll let those be properly talked about on another day. :)

With that said, we have [b]two very cool announcements[/b] for this month, and I hope that I can share those with you as soon as possible!
[url=https://discord.gg/4N2UWEx]Join our Discord[/url] if you want to be one of the first to know what we are doing.

I hope to see you guys soon, and stay tuned for announcements!

notes.title: Halloween Update Released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We just dropped the new Halloween Update (for Gamble Tower Demo!), that contains several UX/QOL improvements and one new challenge for experienced players.

Let’s go a bit more in-depth about the new additions present exclusively during the event, which will be available from October 1 to November 30.

[h2]A strange pumpkin appears…[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40212108/fae311406fee8d26fb1e436ea207f2c3b3560adb.gif[/img]
After entering the intersection for the first time, you’ll see a peculiar pumpkin there, it’s up to you if you want to pick it up or not.

It will only appear once per tower, and always on the first floor.
If you choose to pick it up, you must carry it with you until you get the Gemchip (you must complete the Orbots’s third gamble - Scrambled Scraps - to get the Gemchip) to be able to face the Pumpkin Lord Eskyuven.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40212108/657118a08f6c2a0f069f1b319c94afcd7bceb162.gif[/img]
Trick or Treat?
We won’t spoil this battle for you, good luck!

[h1]Interface Updates[/h1]

This update contains the first batch of updates to the user interface, our goal is to improve the experience with tweaks, and in some cases, complete redesigns of the existing UI.

[h2]Artifacts[/h2]

Now it is easier to scroll through your artifacts in your HUD, additionally, we’ve added a new Interface which allows you to see all your artifacts and their descriptions simultaneously, this interface is also used in the Artifact shop when Orbifying or Removing an Artifact.

[h2]Character HUD[/h2]

The Characters on the battlefield have received a new HUD, which is more compact in order to prevent the screen from getting too cluttered. The new HUD shows the Health and Armor with the form of Horizontal Bars, and the ATK and DEF attribute on the Left Side. Additionally, Ailments are shown on the right side, one at a time.
If you prefer the old, but larger style of HUD, you can re-enable that in the options menu.

[h2]Options menu[/h2]

Talking about the Options menu, the Menu has been entirely redesigned, and is now separated into categories, it is now much easier to find the setting you want.

[h2]More to come in the Future[/h2]

As said before, this is just the first batch of improvements to the UI. There’s much more coming in the future, including, but not limited to:
[list]
[*] A new Sidebar to check the character’s stats and Ailments.
[*] More customization options for the HUD, including Scale, the speed of which Ailments and shown and more.
[*] Better Damage Numbers and Effect descriptions.
[*] Stacking Ailment Messages within a single one (Instead of showing +1 Fury 3 times, shows +3 Fury once instead).
[*] Improvements to the Orb preview in the Pouch.
[*] And many more tweaks and improvements to existing Interfaces.
[/list]

We’ll be updating the demo’s UI along with the development of the full game, but it may take some time in between updates, as we are in the stage of development where we are heavily focusing on new features and content that will only be available in the full game.

[h1]Further updates for Demo?[/h1]
Besides the interface (and bug fixes) updates we don’t have any plans for expanding the demo’s base content, something like a very small Christmas seasonal event may happen, but it also may not (Don’t count on it).
It will depend on whether it’s doable and reasonable for us to focus on other demo updates when the time comes, but for now...

Happy Halloween!
We hope you enjoy our new version of Gamble Tower Demo!

...Trick or treat?

much more stable now.

removing artifacts on the shop could end up removing the wrong artifact.

turn were happening on every turn.
- Fixed an issue where effects that applied on first attack per turn
were happening on every turn.

- Mama Fiend and Lesser Fiend will now give their proper orbs when
captured as enemies. (when summoned by the Orbots)

- Multi-Kill issues such as goblins not spawning and requiring
the wrong amount of kills should not happen anymore.

- Fixed typos on effects that added orbs to your hand (for example

- Fixed Red Magimp's orb text. (It now shows that it applies Fury

open the options menu for it to load.
- Opening "Artifacts" window while having another pouch/orb shop open
will cause visual glitches.
- Ailments and status effects may appear a little weird sometimes (with
spacing, or stuck in an animation)
- Using "Die!" to cause enough damage to make Pumpkin Lord enter rage mode will soft lock the combat, you'll need to reset using the "Debug Me!" option.
- Killing an enemy with a Demon Claw upgraded with Damage Crystal will make your summon whiff.
- The game may still crash in some PCs, specially with crashes related to
video player. (Sorry Drew :( )
A compatibility mode without videos is planned.

Hello everyone!
First of all, thank you all for the amazing support you gave Gamble Tower, there were a lot of incredible videos, feedback, suggestions and more that we received from you, and we really appreciate that!

notes.title: Some Updates!
notes.content:
Hey there! We hope you are doing well.

It has been a while since we posted anything on Steam, so we wanted to share a little bit of what we are doing right now.

We are still learning how to use the platform properly for announcements, but I hope each post is a little bit better than the one before :)

[h1]Features[/h1]
We are currently working on several core features that will be necessary to achieve a full (and satisfying) roguelite deckbuilder experience for Gamble Tower, most of the time-consuming features being the permanent progression related ones, albeit there are always those [i]pesky little bugs[/i] that always takes a toll on us and on the clock.

The progress made on the content itself is going to be listed below, there are lots of things that we made within the development time we had so far, but we chose to talk about the most interesting things.

[h2]Inn[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Dk2XzYQ.jpg[/img]
The inn (still very WIP) is going to be where you'll go after finishing a run, this is where you will be able to [b]buy permanent upgrades[/b], [b]interact with merchants[/b] for [strike]not completely[/strike] entirely legal purchases and carefully select the [b]tower's dangers [/b](the game's difficulty system) between each new run.

[h2]Orb Upgrade System[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/QAr3CCn.png[/img]
Another very recent addition to our cast of merchants was the [b]Crystal Hobgoblin[/b], an unfortunate creature who is forced to sell you [b]upgrade crystals that you can attach to your orbs in order to create very interesting effects and synergies[/b]. (and of course, increase your overall power)

[h2]More Content Variety in General[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ttcbl0a.gif[/img]
Despite the content we already have inside the game, we still want to add a lot of variety to the game's existing mechanics, such as orbs, more upgrade crystals, enemies, segments, bosses and if possible, NPCs.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/IAGtvH6.png[/img]
Of course, this is not our top priority since our main goal when releasing Gamble Tower as an Early Access game is to be able to add that variety while you can play the game by yourself. (and hopefully give us feedback and ideas that we would love to add to the game!)

[h1]How is development going? Is there a release date?[/h1]
Unfortunately there is no official release date that we can yet make available to the public, we are currently not working full-time in Gamble Tower, therefore we don't want to announce any date that we would not be able to commit to properly.
The game will still release this year as Early Access and we will keep posting updates as frequently as we can (on Twitter too, if you so wish to follow us there!), but for now, we'll abstain from making a reckless announcement.

We hope you like the game when it is finally ready.
Thank you for reading! Expect news soon.
- Ian.
